Data.title: Samson Mow Shares 5 Urgent Steps for Coldcard Users Facing Losses
Data.body: Bitcoin advocate Samson Mow outlined five immediate actions for users affected by the Coldcard wallet losses following the disclosure of a random number generator vulnerability. His recommendations focus on preserving evidence, reporting thefts, avoiding recovery scams, and documenting information that could support ownership claims.
